identification: Squat vase with flared rim, brown/amber streaked glaze, William McHugh, Launceston, Tasmanian art pottery. Base mark reads 'W McHugh / Tasmania / 18'. The 18 is almost certainly the shape number (other McHugh pieces show 22, 60, 63, 98), not 1918, so the dated, early-piece claim in the title is doubtful. Crazed base glaze, brown glaze spots on base and inside, no chips or cracks seen.
